RingCentralAuth.title: RingCentral Authentication Record
RingCentralAuth.description: Encrypted server-side OAuth credentials, tokens, and metadata for RingCentral integration.

encryptedData.description: AES-256-GCM encrypted payload containing access_token, refresh_token, and token_type.

expiresAt.description: Unix timestamp in ms when access token expires.

connectedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the connection was established.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the last token refresh or status update.

status.description: Connection status: connected, disconnected, or error.

/integrations/{integrationId}.description: Secured server-side integration configurations and encrypted tokens.
